Evolution of Client Retention SPIN-OFF AND LISTING OF PLUXEE (BENEFITS & REWARDS SERVICES) The Group has announced the full spin-off of Pluxee. [#299](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000213499884-299)
As I am sure you have already all seen, we are announcing the details of the Pluxee spinoff. [#16](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002926390-16)

Description of the spin-off During Fiscal 2023, the Group announced a plan to spin-off and list its Benefits & Rewards Services business, now Pluxee, to create two pure players, both leaders in their markets and both with highly cash-generative business models and to strengthen each of the two entities to execute their respective strategies and realize their full potential in high-growth markets. 3.1.5 Pluxee spin-off The project to spin-off Pluxee has advanced significantly. [#1326](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000213499884-1326)
Back in April, we announced our decision to spin-off and list Pluxee. [#63](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002926390-63)
Last April, we announced a project to spin-off and list this business activity, which was renamed Pluxee last June. [#98](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002982691-98)
We are now ready to go ahead with a full Pluxee spinoff. [#66](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000002926390-66)
